label: TCR loci / TAL1

sections.text: TCR loci encode T-cell receptor chains and contain lineage-active regulatory elements.
TAL1 encodes a basic helix-loop-helix transcription factor involved in hematopoietic development.

T-cell-receptor regulatory rearrangements can activate TAL1 expression in developing T cells, disrupting normal lineage-specific transcription. This is an enhancer-driven oncogenic mechanism in T-ALL rather than an asserted chimeric TCR protein.
